description: Set file creation permissions (umask) based on user group membership. Enables collaborative file permissions for specific teams.

parameters.umask: File creation mask to set (octal format)

parameter_help.umask_min: Minimum restrictive umask, don't allow less restrictive

pam_stack_examples: session [success=1 default=ignore] pam_succeed_if.so quiet user notingroup developers

0022.permissions: rw-r--r-- for files, rwxr-xr-x for dirs

0002.permissions: rw-rw-r-- for files, rwxrwxr-x for dirs

0027.permissions: rw-r----- for files, rwxr-x--- for dirs
0027.use_case: Very restrictive, only user can access

combination_with_succeed_if.flow: 1. Check if user is NOT in developers group. 2. If yes, set umask=0022. 3. Otherwise skip to next rule setting umask=0002.

benefits: Prevents permission issues when sharing files
notes: Combine with pam_succeed_if for group-based rules. Default umask often too restrictive for team environments.
